sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_notifications (tenantId,userId,workflowId,notificationType,title,message,status,channel,createdDate) SELECT DISTINCT gc.tenantId,utr.userId,gc.workflowId,'contract_issued',CONCAT('Contract issued: ',gc.contractName),CONCAT(:actor,' issued version ',gc.contractVersionNumber,'.'),'unread','in_app',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles utr ON utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode IN ('agreements.drafts.edit','agreements.issue') AND p.isActive=1 WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status='issued' AND utr.userId<>:issuerUserId
